releases.name: v0.1.0 — Light Decision MCP
releases.body:
# Light Decision MCP v0.1.0

**English** | [简体中文更新说明](#简体中文更新说明)

Initial public release of **Light Decision MCP** (`light-decision-mcp`) — a zero-dependency ESM multi-backend Decision MCP server (stdio) and [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai) plugin (`tools` + visual `page`) for fast, probability-calibrated **System One** decision models (`noul` / yes-no, `choice`, `score`).

### Highlights
- **6 Core MCP Tools**: `decide`, `choose`, `yes_no`, `score`, `decide_batch`, and read-only `status` (with live backend health, circuit breaker state, capabilities, and available models).
- **Multi-Backend & Magpie-Decoupled**:
  - **Recommended Local Gateway**: [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai) (native `/v1/decisions` + `/v1/systemone`, zero stored keys, automatic `gateway.json` discovery).
  - **On-Device Local**: `local-opendecider` (`http://127.0.0.1:8001`) and Magpie-managed Ollama / MLX / oMLX.
  - **Direct Cloud & Aggregators**: Google Gemini Decisions (`gemini-decision-1`), TypeSafe Jev (`jev-latest`), Perplexity Decisions (`pplx-decider-v1.3` with optional `web_grounding`), OpenAI Decisions (`gpt-6-luna`), **OpenRouter** (`/api/alpha/decisions`), self-hosted **LiteLLM Proxy**, and custom Decisions / System One gateways.
- **3 Routing Modes + Per-Backend Circuit Breaker**: `api_with_local_fallback` (0 ms open-circuit skip & timeout split), `api_only`, and `local_only` (hard-locks `on-device`). Includes a multimodal safety gate that refuses silent image drop on text-only local fallback unless explicitly opted in.
- **Cross-Protocol Alignment**: Normalizes `input` vs. `state`, array/map probabilities, Gemini expected-float vs. OpenDecider integer-index `score`, and transparently aliases non-ASCII/spaced question IDs on the wire (`[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}`).
- **Visual Settings & Admin Console**:
  - Embedded Magpie visual plugin page (`page/index.html`, zero daemon, theme & language matched).
  - Standalone loopback-only Web Admin UI (`light-decision-mcp ui`, `127.0.0.1:4395`, CSRF-protected, bilingual zh/en, one-click preset picker, `0600` / macOS Keychain secret manager with zero key echo, live playground, hardware advisor, and MCP client snippets including **CC Switch**).
- **Hardware-Aware Setup Wizard**: `light-decision-mcp doctor`, `recommend`, `setup`, and `key set|list|rm [--keychain]`.

### Quick Install
```bash
# As a Magpie Plugin (recommended — zero stored keys)
magpie plugin add github:light-cheng/Light-Decision-MCP

# Standalone Web Admin Console (zero Magpie required)
npx light-decision-mcp ui
```

---

## 简体中文更新说明

**Light Decision MCP**（`light-decision-mcp`）首个公开版本发布——一款零外部依赖的 ESM 多后端 **System One 决策模型** MCP 服务（stdio）与 [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai) 插件（`tools` + 可视化 `page`），提供高速、带校准概率的 `noul`（是/否）、`choice`（多选）与 `score`（有序打分）能力。

### 核心亮点
- **6 个核心 MCP 工具**：`decide`、`choose`、`yes_no`、`score`、`decide_batch` 以及只读 `status`（实时后端健康状态、熔断器监控、多模态/联网能力与可用模型探测）。
- **多后端统一路由，完全与 Magpie 解耦**：
  - **推荐本地网关**：[Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai)（原生全协议支持 `/v1/decisions` 与 `/v1/systemone`，插件零存 Key，自动发现 `gateway.json`）。
  - **本机纯离线**：`local-opendecider`（`127.0.0.1:8001`）及 Magpie 托管的 Ollama / MLX / oMLX。
  - **云端直连与聚合 / 自托管网关**：Google Gemini Decisions（`gemini-decision-1`）、TypeSafe Jev、Perplexity Decisions（支持 `web_grounding` 联网决策）、OpenAI Decisions（`gpt-6-luna`）、**OpenRouter** 云端聚合（`/api/alpha/decisions`）、开源自托管 **LiteLLM Proxy** 以及任意自定义 Decisions / System One 网关。
- **3 种路由模式 + 单后端熔断器**：`api_with_local_fallback`（故障秒切本地、熔断窗口 0 ms 跳过主力、主备超时分段预算）、`api_only`、`local_only`（自动锁死仅本机不出网）；含图片请求遇纯文本本地后端默认拒绝静默丢图降级。
- **跨协议精准对齐**：统一对齐 `input`/`state`、数组/对象概率映射、Gemini 浮点期望分与 OpenDecider 整型档位，并自动在通信层对中文/带空格的问题 ID 做合规别名映射与还原。
- **双可视化配置界面**：
  - **Magpie 内嵌插件页**（`page/`，零守护进程，自动跟随亮/暗主题与中英文）。
  - **独立本地 Web 管理后台**（`light-decision-mcp ui`，仅绑定 `127.0.0.1`，CSRF 防护，完整中英双语，内置 OpenRouter / LiteLLM / 局域网节点一键模板、`0600` 与 macOS 钥匙串密钥管理且零明文回显、在线试跑、硬件实测推荐与含 **CC Switch** 在内的各客户端 MCP 接入配置）。
- **硬件实测推荐与命令行向导**：内置 `doctor`、`recommend`、`setup` 与 `key set|list|rm [--keychain]`。

### 快速安装
